title: save.mismatch
description: The hidden game's save and this world's last save pair don't match (crash recovery): the client warns the player.

kind.description: hidden_behind: same pair, but the hidden game went back to it (Pokémon received since are still in Minecraft and the story may repeat them); world_behind: same pair, but Minecraft went back to an earlier save (Pokémon the story gave since are missing); hidden_older/hidden_newer: the hidden game runs from another save than the world's pair, older or newer; new_game: a New Game in a world that has a pair; other: a different save of unknown age.

ops.description: How many Pokémon operations differ (hidden_behind, world_behind).
